purpose: Define access to the official Hello/Rendezvous shared service as a license-linked service entitlement while keeping commercial entitlement separate from identity, certification and application authorization.

topics.name: Hello Licensed Shared-Service Access
topics.purpose: Define access to the official Hello/Rendezvous shared service as a license-linked service entitlement while keeping commercial entitlement separate from identity, certification and application authorization.

semantics.service_rule: Official Hello/Rendezvous may be available to applicable licensed AIGMos sites/organizations.
semantics.standard_rule: Standard licensed sites may use the official rendezvous/signaling shared service according to the active commercial license policy.
semantics.supported_rule: Supported/OEM and Enterprise tiers may use the same shared service subject to their license terms.
semantics.identity_rule: License entitlement identifies service eligibility, not peer semantic identity.
semantics.cert_rule: Certification status is separate from shared-service entitlement.
semantics.authority_rule: Shared-service entitlement does not grant remote application/data rights.
semantics.failure_rule: No entitlement/service availability produces explicit service-access failure rather than fallback into hidden authorization.

invariants.rule: Hello/Rendezvous performs peer discovery/bootstrap only; it never becomes application-payload owner, semantic peer identity, or authorization authority.

hard_gates.condition: license entitlement treated as remote application permission
service availability treated as remote data authority

references.purpose: Hello is a licensed shared service where applicable.

prose.summary: Define access to the official Hello/Rendezvous shared service as a license-linked service entitlement while keeping commercial entitlement separate from identity, certification and application authorization.
